decisions.value: Operator-owned Cloudflare Workers/D1 installation; connect external apps through OIDC.

value.appliesTo: Every new account, including password/social/enterprise first-login provisioning; independent of app grants and admin rights.

value.endUsers: configured independently for each app in either access mode

value: public beta after security and end-to-end gates

value.client: OIDC registration with an immutable unique mapping to one logical app
value.model: Allow multiple explicit clients per app in storage; create one per app in the first UI
value.activation: Create disabled. Activate only after client mapping and explicit policy/MFA selection. Orphans deny.

value.identity: Stable internal Nathan user ID; never an email address or display name
value.groups: Flat groups with direct user membership and immutable IDs
value.grants: OR across explicit user/group grants; user/app blocking overrides every grant
value.deletion: No reuse of group IDs or inheritance by same-name recreation
value.globalRoles: Administrative privilege only; no implicit application entitlement

accepted: Verified primary authentication plus a Nathan TOTP challenge
Nathan passkey authentication only with server-verified user verification and an accepted multifactor ceremony model
value.rememberedDevices: Do not satisfy a fresh MFA requirement
value.recovery: Invalidate prior evidence and require a new qualifying ceremony
value.protocol: Preserve provider-owned claims; acr remains 0 until a supported truthful mapping exists.

value.newAppMfaDefault: required, with explicit choice before activation
value.refreshRotation: Each use, zero reuse grace. Reject unsupported override. Enforce absolute family expiry rather than a sliding unlimited lifetime.
value.notes: Validate supported options and persist original deadlines where the provider defaults slide. These are design candidates, not current behavior or accepted user requirements.

value.definitions: Concurrency counts unfinished journeys, not completed logins/second. Traffic is aggregate per installation. Synthetic load and live provider compatibility are separate.

decisions.value: Confidential server web apps using authorization code and S256 PKCE. Defer native/mobile, device, machine, arbitrary plugins and management MCP writes until separately scoped.

value.email: Operator-supplied Resend credentials and verified sender, matching the existing adapter. Verify delivery before enabling password/invitation journeys; retries and redacted failures must be usable.
value.distribution: Versioned integrity-verified standalone CLI artifact; secure an operator-owned npm scope before advertising an npx command. Do not assume a package name is available.

value.representativeUse: At least one representative larger installation; controlled load proves the profile separately. Quiet pilot traffic is insufficient.
value.blockingFindings: No unresolved release-blocking security or correctness findings
value.ownership: Named release/support/security owners and disclosure channel before public beta; production independent review before support commitment.

enforcementPoints.required: Current enabled app/client, active user, explicit entitlement and sufficient session MFA before any final code. Cover consent, continuation, silent and login-resume paths.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Global dispatch middleware plus a narrowly filtered final-code verification-create guard; postLogin alone is insufficient.
enforcementPoints.status: supported surfaces inspected; composition requires executable proof

enforcementPoints.required: Recheck current policy using the validated code-bound user/session/client, preserving PKCE, client authentication, one-time use and exact callbacks.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Verified-context contributor plus any needed deny-only dispatch guard; restrict every supported user grant to effective openid.
enforcementPoints.status: candidate; no universal provider authorization hook established

enforcementPoints.required: Recheck user/app/grants/MFA and original session; preserve rotation and original assurance/family deadlines.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Same verified-context guard; explicitly zero reuse grace. A positive grace needs a guard before cached replay or remains unsupported.

enforcementPoints.required: Default invitation-only applies before all user creation and session access, including raw APIs and provider callbacks. Null/missing context cannot bypass admission.
enforcementPoints.candidate: databaseHooks.user.create.before with verified source/context; authoritative invitation reservation/consumption and an inactive recoverable state if a multi-write operation cannot be atomic.
enforcementPoints.status: hook supported; provider coverage and D1 transaction boundary unproven

enforcementPoints.required: Qualifying server-verified UV ceremony, bound to the final successfully created session. Enrollment and possession-only ceremonies are insufficient.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Reject a ceremony counted as MFA unless authenticationInfo.userVerified is true; request-scoped verified data plus a successful session hook records evidence.
enforcementPoints.status: supported verification callback; session composition requires proof

enforcementPoints.required: Record successful challenge for the final active session; handle pending login, existing session and enrollment session replacement distinctly.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Success-aware endpoint after hook plus authoritative final-session lookup; do not infer success from route name or authenticator counts.
enforcementPoints.status: source inspected; replay and evidence binding unproven

enforcementPoints.required: Before upstream forwarding, evaluate trusted app/client and verified app-local session through the common policy; no shared IdP cookie.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Online authorizer using an authenticated app-scoped caller and a server-verified session/token association. Start with primary-authoritative reads, no allow cache.
enforcementPoints.status: production design pending; existing ACR comparison insufficient

enforcementPoints.required: Untrusted request fields cannot select another app or principal; the same 60-second bound applies if this interface ships.
enforcementPoints.candidate: App-scoped credential and verified app-local identity proof; never raw supplied user ID or a cookie unavailable on app hosts. Redesign or keep legacy interface disabled.

enforcementPoints.required: Privileged current-session MFA, stable local IDs, audit, complete authorized search/pagination and no alternate self-grant path.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Nathan-owned group/grant storage and server-side management APIs; organization/global role/upstream groups are not grants.

enforcementPoints.required: Issuer/audience/signature checks alone cannot promise current policy or the Worker revocation bound.
enforcementPoints.candidate: Do not advertise the offline-only SDK as satisfying current Worker authorization; require an online decision or separately bounded supported contract.

worker.boundary: Any newly authorized protected request at or beyond commit + 60 seconds denies. Already authorized in-flight requests are not recalled.

cacheProposal.initial: No allow cache; primary-authoritative online evaluation
cacheProposal.optimization: Only after measurement, fixed allow validity at most 30 seconds from evaluation start, capped by every identity/session/MFA deadline; stale response cannot reset it.
cacheProposal.errors: Fail closed after expiry; never serve stale permission on error
cacheProposal.consistency: Prove reads observe authoritative committed state across D1 sessions, isolates and regions; avoid unbounded replica lag.

worker.longLivedConnections: Design pending: exclude or reauthorize/terminate bounded streams and WebSockets explicitly before claiming coverage.

oidc.consistencyProposal: A fresh authoritative policy evaluation in each grant operation; define the snapshot/linearization point and race tests. Do not claim a transaction spanning a remote app.
oidc.alreadyIssuedTokens: Separate token expiration/online-check contract; token revocation alone cannot end an arbitrary app-local session.

externalSessions.requirements: Pin versions; configure refresh/reauthentication/local session controls; measure last successful protected action after revocation. If 15 minutes cannot be enforced, record the supported limit and obtain an explicit release decision before advertising it.
